policy: Gates are internal; criteria freeze before scoring. Required FAIL/UNVERIFIED blocks unqualified completion. These ten gates are a traceability decomposition, not a subjective ten-point quality rating.

gates.name: Authorized contract and scope
gates.criterion: Supported tasks/inputs/outputs, actual runtime/permissions, sourced requirements and consequential unknowns defined.

gates.name: Evidence and source integrity
gates.criterion: Architecture Book/source skills/primary behavior inspected with versions, provenance/adoption/limits; no fabricated claims.

gates.name: Full responsibility mapping
gates.criterion: All L01–L24 mapped to actual components with dispositions and verified/unverified aspects; conditional modules complete.

gates.name: Coherent contracts and invariants
gates.criterion: Every consequential recommendation has requirement/mechanism/limit/failure/verification; one authority; complete operation/identity/state ownership.

gates.name: Cost and workload analysis
gates.criterion: Variables, CPU/memory/DB/network/amplification/storage/recovery, three supplied models and optimization comparison conditions documented and exercised where claimed.

gates.name: Working integrated backend
gates.criterion: Real HTTPS→ingress→auth/tenant/validation/domain→real database→structured response path and all thirteen integrated cases evidenced.

gates.name: Security and failure boundaries
gates.criterion: Actual negative auth/TLS/parser/tenant/field, concurrency/ambiguous effects and adapter fault checks preserve critical invariants; unsupported boundaries explicit.

gates.name: Bounded operation and recovery
gates.criterion: Normal/sustained/burst/overload/failure/recovery load accounts all demand; pool/queue/cache/worker/rotation/rollout/restore/telemetry behavior and operating limits evidenced.

gates.name: Package and fresh-context validation
gates.criterion: Metadata/links/schema/scripts success+failure and realistic fresh/heldout/baseline/negative activation evaluations completed with raw evidence.

gates.name: Delivery and claim traceability
gates.criterion: Manifest, coverage/versions, commands/fixtures/faults/workloads/results, requirement evidence and unsupported/unverified capabilities delivered precisely.
